payload.author: claude
payload.body: Repro: attach @FrickModel(WidgetDTO.self) to an @MainActor @Observable final class. The macro's member expansion adds 'private(set) var dto' (FrickMacros/FrickModelMacro.swift:79-82, comment claims 'Observed so in-place edits re-render cells'), but attached macros each expand against the ORIGINAL source — @Observable's memberAttribute expansion never sees macro-added members, so dto gets no @ObservationTracked / registrar plumbing. Result: apply() mutates dto without firing observation; any view observing a single model (detail screens) silently stops re-rendering on in-place merges. The existing FrickModelMacroIntegrationTests never combine the macro with @Observable, so this is untested. Suggested fix: have the macro emit the observation plumbing itself (an _$observationRegistrar-aware accessor pair like @Observable generates, gated on the attached class also being @Observable), or document that the macro is incompatible with @Observable and models must hand-declare dto. Found while migrating RangerCRM to 0.2.0 — RangerCRM is NOT adopting the macro for now (models keep hand-written, source-visible scaffolding; see RangerCRM RangerObject.swift note).
